status: Six native views inspected against cited originals; accepted as a development reconstruction with explicit remaining approximations
source_constraints: HB191 supplies three connection tube stocks and cast-with ownership; exact transitions into the casting are estimated.
LIB79, SNL17 and HB52 establish geared shaft, bearing, conical support, packing/glands/spring, open impeller and inlet cover ordering.
HB139 shows a doubled connection between the drain plug and cover fastening; exact cross-hole, stud choice, bends and twist are estimates.
limits: Qualitative source comparison; no source-camera registration or pixel agreement claimed.
Casting contours, commercial bearing internals, packing envelopes, fastener details and formed wire attachment retain documented approximations.
Sections, crop boundaries and exploded separations alter display only; they are not service poses.
Accepted development checkpoint does not establish a complete pump, engine or tank.

view_findings.isometric.png: Integral inlet elbow and opposed outlet branches remain recognizable against HB52/SNL17. Source-stock straight ends are longer and thinner than the prior snapshot; the drain wire is now visible below the cover.
view_findings.section.png: Open inlet, shaft, bearing, two packing/gland locations, intervening spring and open impeller are visible in the source ordering of LIB79/HB139. Wire passes the drain plug below the body.
view_findings.section_iso.png: Six-blade open impeller and the packing/spring train remain distinct. The section exposes intended fluid space and the transition from thicker cast elbow to the printed thin straight tube.
view_findings.installed.png: Geared shaft aligns with the lower vertical driver and case receiver. Cropped casting exposes the mount stack; incomplete surrounding context is deliberate display removal.
view_findings.exploded.png: Retainer, body, open impeller and cover are separated for comparison with SNL17/HB52. Wire moves with the body and is deliberately unhooked from its displayed anchor; this is not an installation or service sequence.
view_findings.drain_lock.png: Doubled route passes through the drain-plug cross-hole and around the selected cover stud, with a twisted tail. Apparent crossings in projection are separated in 3D by native checks. Detached cover fragments from cropping are suppressed in display; no physical shape changes.
